gloss: how something comes out (in a photo); photographic result

definitions.gloss: how something comes out in a photo; photographic result
definitions.explanation: The way a subject appears when photographed — whether it looks good, clear, and well-lit. Combines {写|うつ}り (how something is captured) with {具合|ぐあい} (condition, state).

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{写|うつ}り{具合|ぐあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked how the photo turned out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{写|うつ}り{具合|ぐあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: How photos come out changes with the weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{写|うつ}り{具合|ぐあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{撮|と}り{直|なお}した→撮り直す：25509_torinaosu⟧。
examples.english: I was worried about how my ID photo would come out, so I retook it many times.

notes:
Combines ⟦{写|うつ}り→写り：20375_utsuri⟧ (how a subject is captured on film or in a photo) with ⟦{具合|ぐあい}→具合：01391_guai⟧ (condition, state). Describes how well something photographs — its lighting, clarity, and overall look in the finished image.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写|うつ}り{具合|ぐあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: photographs well; comes out nicely
- {写|うつ}り{具合|ぐあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check how a photo came out

NOTE ON KANJI:
⟦{写|うつ}り→写り：20375_utsuri⟧ uses {写|しゃ} (to photograph or copy). For reflections in a mirror or images on a screen, the homophone ⟦{映|うつ}り→映り：24196_utsuri⟧ (⟦{映|うつ}り→映る：12964_utsuru⟧⟦{具合|ぐあい}→具合：01391_guai⟧) is used instead.
